changelog.text: Left clicks fixed everywhere. Minecraft 26.3 numbers mouse buttons differently, and Lmg was still using the old numbers. That's why the Cosmetics tabs and items ignored left clicks. It also broke a few other things: a left click stepped settings backwards, erased in the crosshair editor, reset held-item sliders and HUD panels, and did the wrong thing on the world map. Clicking your character in the Right Shift menu opens Cosmetics again, and the CPS counter counts left and right clicks correctly.

Small fixes. Your own UID now updates if it changes on the server (it used to stay as the first number you got). The Cosmetics screen writes a line to the game log for each click, to help track down clicks that don't seem to do anything.

"Before you start" fixed. The Got it and Privacy policy buttons no longer sit on top of the text: the card now fits its text, the buttons have proper boxes, and on small windows the text scrolls while the buttons stay put.

Cosmetics clicks fixed. The tabs down the side and the + buttons now react to exactly where they're drawn. And if you were matching your partner's outfit, picking something yourself now stops matching (it used to put their outfit back on you every couple of seconds, so it looked like the buttons did nothing). Turn matching back on with the button at the top.

34 new cosmetics and a new Tails tab. Tails: cat, fox, bunny, devil, dragon and robot, and they swish as you walk. Hats: witch, cowboy, party, flower crown, frog, headphones and a star crown. Glasses: heart, round, star, snow goggles and a monocle. Ears: bear, devil horns, bug antennae and elf. Wings: fairy, dragon and crystal. Auras: heart orbit, planet rings, leaf swirl and spirit flames. Capes: Moonlit Sea, Inferno, Rainbow, Night Forest and Racer. Shared tails show for other Lmg players too.

Pets climb on you. One setting: You > Outfit > Pets climb on me. Your pets on Follow hop up onto your head and shoulders one after another, sit there a while, then hop down and walk about. Players climbing on each other is gone: the Climbing page, its key and the asking are all removed, and so is everything the server kept for it.
